nodes.description: Nonsense-mediated decay reduces expression of selected ROR2 premature-termination alleles. Escape from this surveillance pathway contributes to the distinction between recessive Robinow and dominant brachydactyly alleles, but position alone does not explain all variants.

nodes.description: ROR2 promotes Frizzled-dependent noncanonical WNT5A signaling. In an immortalized Ror1/Ror2-deficient mouse-fibroblast rescue system, Robinow-associated variants reduced GFP-Pdzrn3 reporter degradation and DVL2 phosphorylation to different degrees. The cysteine-rich domain was required for this activity, while constructs lacking the intracellular region retained activity in that assay. Residual signaling in cells lacking both ROR receptors argues against treating ROR2 loss as complete loss of every WNT5A response.

nodes.description: Validated double-null embryos have more severe facial, caudal-axis and limb truncation than Ror2 single mutants; most die by E15.5. Their broad similarity to Wnt5a-null embryos supports overlapping developmental functions of Ror receptors.

Constitutive Ror2 knockout, the reference developmental model for this form. Its value is that it resolves the syndrome into separate developmental defects at separate sites rather than one global growth failure.
